  <main>
    <section class="content" aria-label="写给你的告白">
      <p class="eyebrow">TO MY LOVE</p>
      <h1>想对你说</h1>

      <div class="photo-stage" aria-label="旋转照片立方体">
        <div class="halo"></div>
        <!-- 后方的大爱心轻轻跳动；六个正方形照片面组成缓慢旋转的立方体。 -->
        <svg class="big-heart" viewBox="0 0 200 200" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M100 178 C82 163 15 119 15 69 C15 42 35 24 60 24 C78 24 91 34 100 49 C109 34 122 24 140 24 C165 24 185 42 185 69 C185 119 118 163 100 178 Z"/></svg>
        <div class="photo-cube" id="photo-cube" role="img" aria-label="由照片组成的旋转立方体">
          <div class="cube-face"><img alt="照片 1"></div>
          <div class="cube-face"><img alt="照片 2"></div>
          <div class="cube-face"><img alt="照片 3"></div>
          <div class="cube-face"><img alt="照片 4"></div>
          <div class="cube-face"><img alt="照片 5"></div>
          <div class="cube-face"><img alt="照片 6"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="photo-controls" aria-label="照片切换">
        <button class="arrow" id="prev" type="button" aria-label="上一张照片">‹</button>
        <span class="counter" id="counter">1 / 1</span>
        <button class="arrow" id="next" type="button" aria-label="下一张照片">›</button>
      </div>

      <!-- 在这里修改表白文字和副标题。 -->
      <p class="message">成子泳，和你在一起的每一天，我都很喜欢。</p>
      <p class="subtitle">你的笑容，你陪在我身边的时光，都让我觉得很幸运。以后也想牵着你的手，一起慢慢走下去。</p>
      <button class="music-button" id="music-button" type="button" aria-pressed="false">♫ 播放音乐</button>
      <p class="hint" id="hint">点一下，让浪漫开始</p>

  <script>
    /* ===== 自定义位置 =====
       1. 下方 PHOTO_FILES 已内嵌 7 张照片，直接发送此 HTML 文件即可显示。
          今后若要换图，也可以把图片放在同一文件夹，并将数组项改成文件名。
       2. MUSIC_FILE 已内嵌你提供的 MP3，发送此 HTML 文件即可播放。
          今后若要换歌，也可把新 MP3 放在同一文件夹，并把 MUSIC_FILE 改成文件名。
       3. 上方 .message 和 .subtitle 是表白文字。
    */
    const PHOTO_FILES = [
      "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
      "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
      "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
      "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
      "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
      "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
      "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
    ];
    const MUSIC_FILE = "data:audio/mpeg;base64,";

    const placeholder = "data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8," + encodeURIComponent(`
      <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="600" viewBox="0 0 600 600">
        <defs><linearGradient id="g" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#a65c7a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#56314f"/></linearGradient></defs>
        <rect width="600" height="600" fill="url(#g)"/>
        <circle cx="300" cy="220" r="82" fill="#ffffff22"/>
        <path d="M125 525c15-110 95-160 175-160s160 50 175 160" fill="#ffffff22"/>
        <text x="300" y="314" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff1f5" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="25">把我们的照片放在这里</text>
      </svg>`);

    const cubeImages = [...document.querySelectorAll(".cube-face img")];
    const counter = document.getElementById("counter");
    const photos = [];
    let current = 0;
    let carouselTimer;
    cubeImages.forEach(img => { img.src = placeholder; });

    function showPhoto(index) {
      if (!photos.length) return;
      current = (index + photos.length) % photos.length;
      // 六个正方形面一次展示六张；每次切换起点，第七张也会进入立方体。
      cubeImages.forEach((img, faceIndex) => {
        img.src = photos[(current + faceIndex) % photos.length];
      });
      counter.textContent = `${current + 1} / ${photos.length}`;
    }
    function restartCarousel() {
      clearInterval(carouselTimer);
      if (photos.length > 1) carouselTimer = setInterval(() => showPhoto(current + 1), 9000);
    }
    document.getElementById("prev").addEventListener("click", () => { showPhoto(current - 1); restartCarousel(); });
    document.getElementById("next").addEventListener("click", () => { showPhoto(current + 1); restartCarousel(); });

    // 预先检查图片；未找到的文件会跳过，全部缺失时显示占位图。
    Promise.all(PHOTO_FILES.map(src => new Promise(resolve => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => resolve(src);
      img.onerror = () => resolve(null);
      img.src = src;
    }))).then(found => {
      photos.push(...found.filter(Boolean));
      if (photos.length) { showPhoto(0); restartCarousel(); }
    });

    // 粒子数量有限，且只使用 transform/opacity 动画，手机端也能保持流畅。
    const particleBox = document.getElementById("particles");
    const count = matchMedia("(max-width: 480px)").matches ? 18 : 32;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const heart = document.createElement("span");
      heart.className = "particle";
      heart.style.setProperty("--left", `${Math.random() * 100}%`);
      heart.style.setProperty("--size", `${8 + Math.random() * 13}px`);
      heart.style.setProperty("--duration", `${9 + Math.random() * 9}s`);
      heart.style.setProperty("--delay", `${-Math.random() * 18}s`);
      heart.style.setProperty("--drift", `${-60 + Math.random() * 120}px`);
      heart.style.setProperty("--opacity", `${.18 + Math.random() * .35}`);
      particleBox.appendChild(heart);
    }

    const musicButton = document.getElementById("music-button");
    const hint = document.getElementById("hint");
    const audio = new Audio(MUSIC_FILE);
    audio.loop = true;
    audio.volume = .45;
    let playing = false;
    let mode = "";
    let context, melodyTimer, noteIndex = 0;
    const notes = [392, 440, 523.25, 440, 349.23, 392, 440, 329.63, 349.23, 392, 440, 392, 329.63, 349.23, 392, 261.63];

    function playNote(frequency) {
      const now = context.currentTime;
      const osc = context.createOscillator();
      const gain = context.createGain();
      osc.type = "sine";
      osc.frequency.value = frequency;
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.055, now + .025);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001, now + 1.15);
      osc.connect(gain).connect(context.destination);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 1.18);
    }
    async function startFallback() {
      const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AudioContextClass) { hint.textContent = "此浏览器不支持音频播放，请添加 music.mp3"; return false; }
      context ??= new AudioContextClass();
      await context.resume();
      mode = "fallback";
      playNote(notes[noteIndex++ % notes.length]);
      melodyTimer = setInterval(() => playNote(notes[noteIndex++ % notes.length]), 480);
      hint.textContent = "正在播放内置的轻柔旋律";
      return true;
    }
    function setMusicState(on) {
      playing = on;
      musicButton.textContent = on ? "Ⅱ 暂停音乐" : "♫ 播放音乐";
      musicButton.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
    }
    audio.addEventListener("error", async () => {
      if (playing && mode === "file") {
        clearInterval(melodyTimer);
        if (await startFallback()) setMusicState(true);
      }
    });
    musicButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (playing) {
        audio.pause();
        clearInterval(melodyTimer);
        if (context?.state === "running") await context.suspend();
        setMusicState(false);
        hint.textContent = "点一下，继续播放";
        return;
      }
      if (mode === "fallback") {
        if (await startFallback()) setMusicState(true);
        return;
      }
      try {
        await audio.play();
        mode = "file";
        hint.textContent = "正在播放浪漫轻音乐";
        setMusicState(true);
      } catch {
        if (await startFallback()) setMusicState(true);
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
